create.name: Faith Hunter
create.bio:
Faith Hunter is a yoga and meditation teacher and writer who first turned to yoga in the early 1990s while grieving the death of her older brother. She went on to study several styles of yoga, ran two studios in Washington, DC, for close to two decades, and has since trained many teachers in yoga, breathwork and meditation. Her approach, which she calls Spiritually Fly, brings together movement, breath, chanting, music and journaling, and more recently she has added a gentle, body-centred method she names The Soft Rewire.

Her book Spiritually Fly: Wisdom, Meditations, and Yoga to Elevate Your Soul, published by Sounds True, sets out seven guiding principles with practices for each, and she has also written a 52-week journal, The Return to You. Much of her teaching now reaches people through her Spiritually Fly app and membership, recorded certification courses, livestreamed solstice gatherings and her YouTube channel, where she posts yoga classes and guided meditations for each new and full moon. She also leads small destination retreats for women and returns to Kripalu for weekend immersions.

books.title: Spiritually Fly: Wisdom, Meditations, and Yoga to Elevate Your Soul
books.author: Faith Hunter
books.description: Faith's first book, built around seven principles she calls the Spiritually Fly Sutras. Each chapter pairs a piece of her own story with yoga sequences, breath practices, chants and journaling prompts.

courses.title: Body as Home: A Feminine Nervous System Immersion
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, centred on rest and returning to the body. Faith leads restorative yoga, somatic movement, breathwork, meditation, journaling, ritual and sound in a supportive group setting.

courses.title: Spiritually Fly™ Membership
courses.description: Faith's app and online membership, with guided meditations, breath and somatic practices, workshops and weekly resets. New members begin with a five-day challenge and a seven-day free trial.
courses.price: $29.99 USD per month or $288 USD per year

courses.title: Meditation and Mindfulness Certification
courses.description: A self-paced certification for people who want to guide meditation. It includes five recorded training sessions of about ten hours plus extra meditations, covering the history of meditation, breath awareness, the chakras and ways of leading a group.

courses.title: Intuitive Breathwork Course
courses.description: A recorded course in Faith's own style of breathwork, made up of five sessions, instructional videos, a manual and a playlist. It teaches a range of breathing techniques and how to hold space when guiding others.

courses.title: The Chakra Alchemy Practitioner Course
courses.description: A self-paced course on working with the chakras through breath, mudras, meditation and yoga postures. It is aimed at yoga and meditation teachers and anyone wanting to bring chakra work into their own practice.

courses.title: Return to You: A 6-Day Guided Journey Back to Yourself
courses.description: A short guided programme inspired by Faith's journal of the same name. Over six days it combines meditation, breathwork, journaling and reflection, taken at your own pace.
